overview_description.description: Growdash is a business intelligence and analytics tool built specifically for restaurants to support profitable growth strategic decisions across online sales channels. GrowDash is a Dubai-based restaurant technology and AI-driven SaaS company that helps restaurants optimize delivery operations, online advertising, and growth across third-party food delivery platforms. Founded in 2022 by former Talabat leaders Sean Trevaskis and Enver Sorkun, the company develops intelligent analytics and automation tools designed to simplify restaurant performance management in the digital delivery economy. Its flagship AI delivery manager, Aisha, provides real-time insights, campaign optimization, automated recommendations, reporting, and operational analytics that help restaurants improve profitability, marketing efficiency, and customer engagement.
